releaseEvidence: The release's own acceptance.json (11 gates passed, 2 waived by the owner) and docs/chromium-beta-release.md, 'Blanc Beta 2.0.0-beta.2: the first public beta' on chromium/next.

decisions: Show Blanc Beta on /download as its own 'Try Blanc Beta.' section below Install; the four platform cards stay unchanged.
The Download button goes to /dl/beta on the blanc-ping Worker, counted like the other /dl/* routes.
The section names both waived gates as limitations, matching the approved release notes.

claims.text: An early preview of Blanc built directly on Chromium.
claims.evidence: The release is built from the fork's Chromium 158 tree (release.json chromiumVersion 158.0.8127.2); the approved release notes say the same.

claims.text: It installs beside Blanc and never replaces it: Blanc Beta keeps its own data and passkeys, and your regular Blanc is left untouched.
claims.evidence: Own bundle id me.bnfy.blanc.beta and Blanc Beta data folder (release.json); profile-coexistence gate passed on the notarized app; the owner's webauthn checks on the notarized build confirmed the Electron app and its passkeys were untouched.

claims.text: Apple Silicon Macs · macOS 13 or later · 2.0.0-beta.2
claims.evidence: release.json arches [arm64] under the owner's Intel waiver, minimumSystemVersion 13.0, version 2.0.0-beta.2.

claims.text: Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
claims.evidence: native-signature and gatekeeper gates passed; the release's verify-public stage passed on the public DMG.

claims.text: Its checksums are signed with Sigstore.
claims.evidence: SHA256SUMS.sigstore.json is a public asset and verified against the pinned identity in verify-public.

claims.text: Protected video (such as Netflix or Spotify) doesn't play.
claims.evidence: The beta ships without Widevine (enable_widevine = false); the no-drm-handoff gate is waived by the owner for beta.2.

claims.text: Use the regular Blanc for those sites.
claims.evidence: The shipping Electron Blanc plays protected video (castLabs ECS); repeated from the approved release notes.

claims.text: Sync is included but hasn't been checked end to end against the live Sync service, so don't rely on it yet.
claims.evidence: desktop-sync passed against the local Worker; production-sync-real-device is waived by the owner for beta.2.

claims.text: There is no build for Intel Macs, Windows or Linux.
claims.evidence: The release ships one asset per architecture, arm64 only; no fork build exists for Windows or Linux.
